correctness.rationale: For p>=2, choose in each nonzero coordinate a vector of the same norm orthogonal to x_gamma; both distances are exactly sqrt(2). For p<=2, every fixed ell_p vector has coordinates of arbitrarily small norm, so placing a unit orthogonal vector in such a coordinate yields both distances tending to 2^(1/p). The one-coordinate base vector gives the matching upper bound: one sign has first-fibre norm at most sqrt(1+a^2), and monotonicity of (1+a^2)^(p/2)-a^p yields 2^(1/p) below p=2 and sqrt(2) above it. All quantifiers and p=2 boundary check out.
